summary: 2026 WEC Hypercar entry (#12/#38 Cadillac V-Series.R). Front placements are the three brands carried in the team name - Cadillac, Hertz and JOTA - per the repo's WEC convention (team title/name brands mapped to front). Partners from the team's own partners page: Mobil, HRX, Bollé Safety, BRADY and Singer, plus Michelin as the entry's tyre partner per the official FIA WEC entry sheet. The partners page also shows a 'Hertz Racing Gold' logo (a Hertz sub-brand, counted under hertz) and one further logo (podium-13.png) that could not be identified, so the list is not marked complete.
